blocks.text: Power Engineering: Fundamental Electrical Engineering Excellence

blocks.html: Since our establishment, our company has been at the forefront of automating the production processes of electricity and heat. Our specialists possess in-depth knowledge and extensive experience in these critical areas, ensuring top-notch expertise and innovation in power engineering.

blocks.title: Areas of Expertise of Our Specialists:

blocks.text: Areas of Expertise of Our Specialists:

blocks.html: - Condensed Steam Turbine: Expertly designed for efficient energy conversion from steam.
- Back Pressure Steam Turbine: Specialized in optimizing energy recovery in industrial processes.
- Gas Turbines: Advanced solutions for high-efficiency power generation.
- Hydro Turbine: Turbine and governor control for hydroelectric generation.
- Heat Recovery Steam Generator: Maximizing energy efficiency by recovering waste heat.
- Steam Boilers with Gas Combustion Process: Precision-engineered for cleaner, more efficient combustion.
- Steam Boilers with Liquid Fuel Burning Process: Optimized for diverse fuel types and efficient operation.
- Steam Boilers with Mixed Burning Process: Innovative fluidized bed technology for versatile fuel usage (gas/solid fuel/semi-liquid fuel).
- AAF Bags for Cleaning Ash: Effective ash removal systems for steam boilers burning solid fuel.
- City Heating System - District Heating: Comprehensive solutions for efficient and reliable urban heating.
- Eolian Powerplant: Harnessing wind energy for sustainable power generation.

Our commitment to excellence in power engineering and fundamental electrical engineering is unwavering. We continue to push the boundaries of innovation, ensuring that our clients receive the highest quality solutions for their power generation needs.

Power plants under our control systems run unattended and are dispatched remotely over IEC 60870-5-104 telecontrol, carried on four redundant communication channels so that the loss of any single path does not interrupt control or data transfer. Scope covers the telecontrol gateway, signal mapping, redundancy switchover logic and testing of channel failover under load.
Turbine control systems are commissioned and handed over against measured acceptance criteria, not against a checklist. Tests performed:

items.html: Disconnection of the generator from the grid, with the unit held on house load
Emergency stop and overspeed protection, including Braun turbine overspeed systems

blocks.html: Results are recorded and used for the certification of the turbine.

blocks.title: Island mode operation and load rejection

blocks.html: Where a plant has to keep supplying its site after separation from the grid, we implement the governor transfer, load shedding and frequency control that make it possible — proven on a running refinery CHP plant. See Island Mode Operation.

blocks.title: Grid code compliance and system operator interface

blocks.text: Grid code compliance and system operator interface

blocks.html: A generating plant is only connected as long as it answers to the system operator on the operator's terms. We implement that interface.

items.html: Active and reactive power setpoint control from dispatch
Reporting to the transmission system operator over IEC 60870-5-101
Reporting to the market operator over IEC 60870-5-104
Telecontrol over four redundant communication channels, so the loss of one path does not interrupt control or data transfer
Primary and secondary frequency control, with the response measured at acceptance rather than assumed

blocks.html: We have delivered this for conventional plant, for a photovoltaic park and for a wind farm dispatched as one balancing group — see virtual power plant.

Starting a boiler by hand ties up an operator for hours and produces a different result every time, because the sequence depends on who is running it. We implement automatic start-up from a hot state as a sequence in the DCS: purge, burner light-off through the burner management system, ramp to minimum stable load against the drum thermal stress limits, and hand-over to load control.
The value is repeatability. The same ramp, the same stress on the drum, the same fuel consumed, whoever is on shift.

Protection logic implemented across a whole station rather than machine by machine: four turbines, four boilers and the auxiliary equipment, so that a trip on one item takes the correct action on the rest instead of cascading.

Two gas turbines, a heat recovery steam generator and a steam turbine controlled as one unit, with SIL 3 safety systems. We have acted as the investor's representative on a CCPP automatic control system from design review through commissioning and operator training — see Combined Cycle Power Plants.

blocks.text: Understanding the Dynamics of the Oil and Gas Industry

blocks.html: Refinery and gas plants need control systems that work in classified areas, keep the refinery supplied when the grid fails, and report emissions and efficiency to the people who act on the data.

blocks.text: Embracing Automation in the Cement and Coal Industries

blocks.html: Cement production processes are typically discontinuous and operate in batches, while coal industry processes are continuous and run at maximum production capacity.
The implementation of automation solutions addresses these critical needs by ensuring that processes are meticulously controlled and monitored.

blocks.alt: Combined-cycle plant control room with operator consoles and overview display

blocks.html: Control centers are designed with the latest technological advancements, ensuring that they meet the highest standards of safety and reliability. The furniture, meticulously crafted, complements these designs by providing ergonomic solutions that cater to the unique needs of control room operators.
Our designs are not only about enhancing the operational efficiency but also about improving the overall well-being of the operators who spend long hours in these environments.
